t: You're looking at St Peter upon Cornhill, an Anglican church on the corner of Cornhill and Gracechurch Street. Its origins are medieval, and possibly Roman. The Great Fire of 1666 destroyed it, and it was rebuilt to designs by Sir Christopher Wren, who was given the job of rebuilding 52 City churches. Buried here are Sir Christopher Morris, who was Master of the Ordnance under Henry VIII, and John Waugh, who became Bishop of Carlisle in 1723.
